messages.text: Jonah — Mara at Harbor Path. Priya's team asked me to reach out quietly. are you still open to a conversation?
quietly is the only way I can do this. yes
calling in ten. find a door that closes
they want you on site. Thursday night into Friday. I booked The Wren — it's two blocks from Lumen
I can do Thursday. I have to be back Friday night
lobby bar. wear whatever. it's a dinner not a panel
you were good tonight. they already like you and they haven't even seen you in a room
I keep thinking about how to say this at home and I can't get past the first sentence
I liked last night. professionally. mostly. sleep, Jonah
offer should land tonight. don't put it on linkedin. tell your person when you're ready
I don't know if I'm ready
ready for the job or ready for the conversation. those are different and you keep mixing them
if I say the city she will hear leaving. I don't know if that's what I mean
I can't coach you on that. I can get you the letter. the rest is your kitchen
I keep opening the draft and putting the phone face down
stop texting me at 11. go sit next to her. even if you don't say it tonight
